note: Add the types-only `@devup-ui/plugin-utils/types` entry (resolved through `exports`, and `typesVersions` for `node10` resolution) holding the types the plugins' published declarations name. The Next plugin's declarations now import it instead of the whole package, so a `next.config.ts` type check loads 7 of plugin-utils' declaration files instead of 22 (`.next/cache/.tsbuildinfo` about 3.5 KB smaller on the benchmark apps).
